proposed_comments.title: Make the native alpha handoff explicit
proposed_comments.body:
### Make the native alpha handoff explicit

**Severity:** `medium`

The managed helper still serializes the thumbnail as BMP, and the native provider reloads it with `LoadImage` without `LR_CREATEDIBSECTION` before reporting `WTSAT_ARGB`. That API path does not explicitly guarantee the premultiplied 32-bpp DIB required by the shell contract, so the managed alpha tests do not cover the final Explorer handoff. Please use an alpha-preserving handoff (for example PNG decoded through WIC) and return a premultiplied 32-bpp DIB before setting `WTSAT_ARGB`.
